type RawUnicode=`\u{110000}`;
type RawHex=`\xGG`;
type RawShort=`\u123`;
type RawNumeric=`\1`;
type RawZero=`\09`;
type MixedRaw=`\n\u{110000}`;
const rawUnicode:RawUnicode="\\u{110000}";
const rawHex:RawHex="\\xGG";
const rawShort:RawShort="\\u123";
const rawNumeric:RawNumeric="\\1";
const rawZero:RawZero="\\09";
const mixedRaw:MixedRaw="\n\\u{110000}";
console.log(JSON.stringify([rawUnicode,rawHex,rawShort,rawNumeric,rawZero,mixedRaw]));
